title: Singular points for cone actions on the product of certain homogeneous spaces
summary: In this paper, we investigate divergent orbits for cone actions on products of certain homogeneous spaces. We introduce a notion of essential singularity for such actions, and estimate the Hausdorff dimension of the corresponding singular set. In particular, let $G/Γ=\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})^s/\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})^s$, and let $C$ be a cone in the positive Weyl chamber with angular aperture $ε>0$.
